title: A short listening edition
text:
Reading leaves us with more saved articles than time. Listening creates another opportunity to return to them.

A useful note preserves the thought and its source. Keeping it in a chosen folder makes it available to a personal knowledge system.
overview: Turning saved reading into useful notes.
